product.title: Private Tour Oahu Circle Island - Fully Personalized Experience

description.text: A private circle-island tour of Oahu is reserved for one party, with stops and timing set by that party. There is no shared bus and no waiting on other groups. Pickup and drop-off are from the party's accommodations, and the guide covers Hawaiian history during the day. The places on this Honolulu booking are the ones the party chooses, and the party decides how long to remain at each one. The guide's comments on Hawaiian history accompany the party from the accommodation pickup to the drop-off back at those accommodations.
